Presentation.Title: Administrative family office and family governance
Presentation.Subtitle: An administrative and governance partner, no asset management
Intro: Ark Fiduciaire supports families and entrepreneurs who need a Swiss coordination desk for governance, tax, legal and reporting.
We do not provide asset management: our role is administrative and coordination with banks, external asset managers, lawyers and tax advisers, using secure workflows.

Presentation.LongFormTitle: Administrative coordination for families and family structures

LongFormSections.Title: Who we support
Body: Families, entrepreneurs and family structures needing an administrative coordination point in Switzerland or Romandy.
The service covers governance, documentation, reporting, tax follow-up and coordination of advisors.

LongFormSections.Title: What we coordinate
Body: Decision calendars, governance documents, administrative summaries, tax follow-up, and coordination with banks, external managers, lawyers and notaries.
We help make information usable without replacing specialists in their own fields.

LongFormSections.Title: Essential limitation
Body: Ark Fiduciaire does not provide discretionary asset management in this context.
Investment decisions, management mandates and financial recommendations remain with the relevant banks, external managers or authorized advisors.

LongFormSections.Title: Cost drivers and continuity
Body: Costs depend on the number of entities, advisors, countries, meetings, reports and documents to coordinate.
The value is continuity: organized files, traceable decisions and clearly allocated responsibilities.
